fields.description: Length of each repeating window, in days (e.g. 30 = monthly).
fields.label: Interval Day Count

fields.description: How many windows (e.g. 10 monthly windows, covering roughly 6 weeks to 1 year) are automatically calculated. Change this to match however many visits your organization actually uses.
fields.label: Automatic Window Count

fields.description: High Risk only: how many days into each window (from its start) the CHW should be nudged to visit early. Also used for the urgent follow-up chain's timing after a Risk-completed visit.
fields.label: Risk Alert Days

fields.description: How many completed visits close out one window before moving to the next.
fields.label: Visits Required Per Window
